site_description: Support for Madeira businesses that accept Bitcoin: a practical, step-by-step guide from FREE Madeira.
home_headline: 170+ businesses in Madeira already accept Bitcoin.
home_sub: You won't be the first, but you can be the best. Here, bitcoiners can live on Bitcoin. It's a recognised Bitcoin destination, and your business is the next stop.
home_doors_label: The guide, in order of usefulness
faq_lead: Short answers, taken from the guide.
faq_none: We found nothing. Ask us in the merchant support WhatsApp group or by email, below.
flyer_lead: The flyer we leave in shops: open it here and print it on A4, both sides.
contact_text: We are FREE Madeira, a non-profit association founded in 2022, the team behind Bitcoin Atlantis. We help you set everything up, free of charge, and we're glad to help if something goes wrong.
contact_whatsapp_text: Live questions with FREE and other merchants.
atlantis_title: Be a merchant at Bitcoin Atlantis
atlantis_text: Want to be at Bitcoin Atlantis as a merchant? Write to us and we'll tell you the next steps. And if you'd like to support FREE Madeira and Atlantis as a sponsor, see how.
atlantis_button: I want to be a merchant at Atlantis
home_guide_in_portuguese: The full guide is in Portuguese only, for now.
footer_published: a practical guide for merchants on the island of Madeira. Published by Associação FREE Madeira — Fórum Regional para a Educação Económica. Edition 1.0, September 2026, adapted for the web.
footer_licence_post: : you may copy, print, translate and adapt it, as long as you give credit and share alike.
footer_inspired: This guide was inspired by Bitcoin Coast — Guía de Bitcoin para Comerciantes, written by Evelyn Lemus (Berlín, El Salvador) and placed in the public domain. We rewrote it from scratch for Madeira.
footer_disclaimer: Educational material. Not financial, tax or legal advice: for accounting and taxes, always talk to your accountant.
